value.rationale: The periodic cooperative invasion-equality boundary is explicitly identified as unresolved by the motivating 2024 paper. At this degenerate zero Floquet exponent, strict exponential extinction criteria cease to apply. The theorem proves global convergence from every positive interior state, two universal positive periodic inverse-time amplitudes including eventual one-sided resident approach, and an exact forcing-independent cycle-mean extinction coefficient \(1/(d_1-\sigma\tau/d_2)\). These are structural critical dynamics, not a textbook logistic corollary or an arbitrary computation.
